:::{#exr-prac-exp-mle-maximum}
#### Check the critical point is a maximum

In the setting of @exr-prac-exp-mle,
use the second derivative from @exr-prac-exp-mle-second-derivative to verify that the [critical point](#def-critical-point) $\hat\pmean_{ML}$ from @exr-prac-exp-mle-mle is a maximum.

:::
